name: opacity
description: Properties for configuring the materials transparency.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Indicates the general approach how transparency is to be applied.

properties.name: alphaSource
properties.description: Indicates whether to get the opacity texture from the Base Color map (Packed) or from a separate greyscale texture (Split).

properties.name: factor
properties.description: Factor for cutout threshold and blending

properties.name: alphaAffectsSpecular
properties.description: How much the alpha value should also affect specular reflection. This should be 0.0 for materials where light can transmit through their physical surface (like glass), but 1.0 when alpha determines the very presence of a surface (like hair or grass)

properties.name: edgeSoftness
properties.description: Width of the anti-aliased transition band around the cutout threshold, rendered with alpha-to-coverage. 0.0 = use the Alpha to Coverage Sharpness ramp instead. A screen-space adaptive minimum (~1 pixel) is always applied so edges stay anti-aliased at any distance.

properties.name: alphaToCoverage
properties.description: Enables Alpha-to-Coverage (A2C) for anti-aliased cutout edges using MSAA. Only applies to Cutout opacity mode. Also enabled implicitly when Edge Softness > 0. The o_alphaToCoverage shader option is set by the StandardPBR_HandleOpacityMode.lua functor so it always matches the A2C render state.

properties.name: alphaToCoverageSharpness
properties.description: Steepness of the alpha-to-coverage edge ramp, used when Edge Softness is 0. Higher values produce sharper cutout edges with a narrower anti-aliased band.
